data.one_liner: Adds drag and drop reordering functionality to existing GridView.builder widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DraggableGridViewBuilder widget that allows users to reorder items inside a grid through drag and drop gestures. It supports customization via callbacks for feedback widgets, placeholders, and completion handlers.
use_when: You need a grid view where users can rearrange items by dragging and dropping.
You want a drop-in replacement for GridView.builder with drag capabilities.
avoid_when: You require complex staggered grid layouts (use flutter_staggered_grid_view instead).
You don't need drag and drop functionality.
strengths: Easy to implement with few lines of code
Cross-platform support including mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: You are responsible for permanently storing the reordered list results

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need complex, non-uniform staggered grid layouts instead of standard uniform grids.

data.minimal_example:
DraggableGridViewBuilder(
  gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
    crossAxisCount: 2,
    childAspectRatio: 1.0,
  ),
  children: _listOfDraggableGridItem,
  dragCompletion: (List<DraggableGridItem> list, int beforeIndex, int afterIndex) {},
)
